acceptance_criteria.criterion: The 'Seeding the Test Database' section in `testing.md` documents the two-phase process-isolated model (`seed-truncate.php` → `seed-insert.php`)
No references to manual `resetCollection()` maintenance remain in the seed documentation
No `APP_SEED_MODE` internal implementation details are exposed in the seed documentation
No non-idempotency warning exists in the Seeding Locales subsection

summary: Audited testing.md against all four WP-006 acceptance criteria. The WP-005 documentation pass had already rewritten the 'Seeding the Test Database' section with the two-phase process-isolated model. Two residual issues required fixing: (1) line 246 exposed `APP_SEED_MODE` as an internal implementation detail in the step-1 description — removed the `(APP_SEED_MODE)` parenthetical; (2) line 249 retained a reference to manually calling `resetCollection()` after truncation — removed the sentence. The Seeding Locales subsection already carried no non-idempotency warning. All four acceptance criteria are now met.

comments.note: AC1 confirmed met: the 'Seeding the Test Database' section clearly describes the two-step sequence (seed-truncate.php then seed-insert.php) with process isolation explanation.

AC2 fix applied: removed the sentence 'Process isolation replaces the previous approach of manually calling `resetCollection()` after truncation.' — this was the only remaining resetCollection() reference in the seed docs.
AC3 fix applied: removed `(APP_SEED_MODE)` from the seed-truncate.php step description. APP_SEED_MODE is an internal bootstrap flag and should not be surfaced in developer-facing seed documentation.
AC4 confirmed met: no non-idempotency warning exists in the Seeding Locales subsection — the section correctly documents the method as idempotent, consistent with the WP-003 implementation.
